question: List the names of all plans.
How many bikes have the status 'active'?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike WHERE status = 'active'

question: For each city, how many stations are there? Give the city and the count.
gold_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) FROM station GROUP BY city

question: Give the member_id and full name of every member on the Student plan.
gold_sql: SELECT m.member_id, m.full_name FROM member m JOIN plan p ON p.plan_id = m.plan_id WHERE p.name = 'Student'

question: Give the model name and manufacturer of every electric model with a battery of more than 500 Wh.
gold_sql: SELECT name, manufacturer FROM model WHERE is_electric = 1 AND battery_wh > 500

question: Give the bike_id of every bike that has more than one unresolved maintenance record.
gold_sql: SELECT bike_id FROM maintenance WHERE resolved_on IS NULL GROUP BY bike_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

question: What is the name and capacity of the station with the second-largest capacity?
gold_sql: SELECT name, capacity FROM station ORDER BY capacity DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1

question: Give the member_id of every member whose average trip distance is greater than the average trip distance across all trips.
gold_sql: SELECT member_id FROM trip GROUP BY member_id HAVING AVG(distance_km) > (SELECT AVG(distance_km) FROM trip)

question: For each manufacturer, give the manufacturer and the number of distinct bikes of theirs that have at least one maintenance record.
gold_sql: SELECT mo.manufacturer, COUNT(DISTINCT b.bike_id) FROM bike b JOIN model mo ON mo.model_id = b.model_id WHERE b.bike_id IN (SELECT bike_id FROM maintenance) GROUP BY mo.manufacturer
